summary: Iter31 Payroll (Wyplaty) tests: 12/12 backend pytest PASSED + UI flow validated end-to-end. PDF generated 42008 bytes (application/pdf, attachment header). Payout formula verified: hours_amount - advances_zl - penalties - housing - other_minus + bonus + driver + other_plus. Month navigation, search input, editable rate/zaliczki/kary/dodatki, real-time computed payout, and PDF download all working. RBAC: GET/POST/PUT payroll without token returns 401/403.

minor.issue: body {employee_ids: []} returns 200 (treats as 'all') rather than 400 'Brak pracownikow' as suggested in spec; backend code uses 'if payload.employee_ids:' which is falsy for empty list. Unknown employee IDs correctly return 400. Acceptable behaviour but spec says empty list should 400.

ui_bugs.issue: Clicking [data-testid='payroll-select-all'] header checkbox did not check the row(s) - 'PDF wybranych (0)' counter stayed at 0 with 1 visible row. shadcn Checkbox may require pointer events not bypassed by force=True, OR onCheckedChange handler may need verification with real click. Individual row checkboxes were not retested.

action_items: Investigate why payroll-select-all checkbox does not register a click in Playwright force-click; verify individual row checkboxes also work and that 'PDF wybranych (N)' counter updates correctly with real user interaction.

(Optional) Make POST /api/payroll/pdf with employee_ids=[] return 400 'Brak pracownikow' explicitly (current behaviour treats [] as 'all'). Code: change `if payload.employee_ids:` to `if payload.employee_ids is not None:`.
critical_code_review_comments: routes/payroll.py _calc parses floats safely with `or 0` fallback - good defensive coding for empty record cases.

list_payroll: end_day=31 used for $lte string comparison on YYYY-MM-DD - works because ISO date strings sort lexicographically. Safe but a $lt next-month boundary would be more precise (e.g., '2026-05-01').
list_payroll loops all employees and computes for each even if no record/hours - O(N) per render, fine for typical workforce sizes.

_try_register_font: silently swallows registration errors and falls back to Helvetica (no Polish chars). On preview container DejaVu likely missing - PDF will use Helvetica. Verified test passed: PDF=42KB, content-type=application/pdf. Polish chars stripped per spec (zl, godziny etc) so non-issue.
PdfRequest: employee_ids=[] is treated identically to None due to Python falsy check `if payload.employee_ids:` - minor deviation from spec.
PayrollAdmin.js: NumCell uses defaultValue + key to reset on prop change - correct React pattern for uncontrolled-with-server-sync inputs.
saveRecord performs optimistic UI update of computed values - reduces perceived latency, computes match backend formula exactly. Good.
downloadPdf revokes object URL after a.click() synchronously - in modern browsers this is fine because click triggers download synchronously, but a setTimeout(0) revoke would be safer.

success_rate.frontend: ~90% (all selectors render & PDF downloads; select-all click did not register)

seed_data_creation: Used existing 'Jan Testowy' employee. PUT writes payroll_records {rate:60, advances_hours:1, penalties_zl:50, housing_zl:200, other_minus_zl:30, bonus_zl:150, driver_zl:80, other_plus_zl:20} for year=2026,month=4 - leaves test data behind (not cleaned up; harmless for next iteration).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend payroll endpoints all green. Auth endpoint is /api/auth/admin/login (NOT /api/auth/login). PDF size ~42KB for 1 employee - per-page layout 2x3=6 cards, multi-page via c.showPage() (not exercised since DB has only 1 active employee 'Jan Testowy' id=d557f1c2-988b-4ff2-82c6-3b27374e84a8). For multi-page test, seed >6 employees and POST /api/payroll/pdf, then assert PDF has >1 page (re-parse with PyPDF2). To repro select-all issue: log in as admin -> Wyplaty tab -> April 2026 -> click header [data-testid='payroll-select-all'] -> check counter on [data-testid='payroll-pdf-selected'].
